newsitem.title: UK: PREMIER FARNELL SEES HIT FROM STG STRENGTH.
newsitem.headline: PREMIER FARNELL SEES HIT FROM STG STRENGTH.

text.p: British electronics components group Premier Farnell Plc said on Monday the appreciation of sterling would hit the group's first-half overseas profits by five million stg.
Premier said the group continued to make progress with each of the operating divisions showing year-on-year sales growth during the first half. Interim results are due on October 13.
The company's Catalogue distribution division, which represents around 70 percent of Premier's sales and profits, had a first-half sales increase of 3.5 percent on the previous year.
By 0729 GMT, shares in the company were quoted 1-1/2p higher at 534p.
